description: NIST's FTC-07, its AP242 e2 edition's faces #3915 and #9945 on either side of a B-spline edge whose read tolerance is 7.8e-4 and which turns 45° within its first 1e-3 of length. The checker's E8 found it crossing itself at t = 4.8e-4 and 1.9e-3: two segments 7.77e-4 apart with 7.82e-4 of curve between, a bend whose chord is shorter than its arc. A crossing now needs the curve to leave the tolerance ball between them Open CASCADE's healed faces are not the file's: on the sphere its pcurves of the two B-spline edges lie up to 0.1 and 0.036 from their 3D curves (lengths 1.21 and 1.19), where Arris's lie within 7.8e-4, so its area may differ by up to that band, 0.163 mm² or 2.04e-3 relative; it differs by 1.3e-3. The area tolerance is that band; the inertia's that band times the diagonal squared over the tensor's largest component, 0.027; the centroid's is that band times the sheet's diagonal (34.9) over its area, 0.072
